title: Scheduled tasks
empty_body: Click New in the top right, or say something like "send me a morning brief at 9 every day" or "check in every 30 minutes" in a chat, and Persona will do it on schedule.
scheduled_footer_zone: When it's time, Persona follows the prompt and sends the result to your phone. Times of day are in {zone}.
scheduled_footer_browser: When it's time, Persona follows the prompt and sends the result to your phone. Times of day are in {zone}; the next run times here are in this browser's time ({browser}).
scheduled_footer_local: When it's time, Persona follows the prompt and sends the result to your phone. Times of day are in your time zone.
follow_ups_footer: Persona schedules these for itself in chats, then wakes up on time to carry on.
follow_ups_footer_pointer: Persona schedules these for itself in chats, then wakes up on time to carry on. Right-click one to run it now or delete it.
runs_empty: No runs yet. Every run of a scheduled task or follow-up, including failed and skipped ones, shows up here.
